live_book.known_hole: Live book has zero Indonesia / IDN pins (campuses.json projects=70, country_iso3 IDN=0). Dry-run only; not published this hunt.

method_notes: Sweep of Equinix, Digital Realty Bersama, AirTrunk, Vantage, STACK, NTT, STT GDC, Keppel, CapitaLand, DayOne/GDS, ESR, PDG, Colt, DCI Indonesia, Telkom/NeutraDC/Telin, Indosat/BDx, XL Axiata, Biznet, EdgeConneX, Digital Edge, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta, Apple, Princeton Digital, SpaceDC, Elitery.

Places swept: Jakarta districts (Kuningan, Jatinegara, Kalideres, Cilandak hints), Bekasi/Cikarang/GIIC/Cibitung, Karawang (empty primary), Bogor (Keppel empty SoR), Tangerang, Bandung/Surabaya portfolio-only, Batam Nongsa/Kabil, Nusantara/IKN (empty), KIIC/Jababeka host parks.

Every include:true row fetched from company IR/press/official DC or Telkom/gov-adjacent primary naming the place. Grain verbatim. Equinix JK1 held (IBX cabinets). Sub-250 disclosed pins stay. Cloud regions rejected. PPAs and portfolio/power commitments rejected as pins. Do not publish. Do not message other agents.
